opening: The Writer’s Birthday Gift. I gave my favorite horror writer a pen containing a camera at his birthday party. I returned home satisfied. But when he returned to his own home, I was horrified. Why?
answer: I intended to spy on him. Through the camera, I saw human heads and limbs hanging on his walls and blood on the floor. I realized his vivid stories of murder and dismemberment described his own crimes, rather than fictional events.
